what: HIGH (code audit CA-A01-020, MEASURED): The reverse reconciler's orphan test is set MEMBERSHIP on (symbol, side), not quantity, so a venue position larger than the sum of the journal's open rows on that (symbol, side) is never detected — the untracked surplus is reported as 0 orphans. LOCATION: src/runtime/order_monitor.py:L3260-L3267, L3671-L3672. PROPOSED FIX: Aggregate venue size per (symbol, canonical side) and journal open position_size per the same key; when venue exceeds journal by more than the existing _BYBIT_QTY_DIVERGENCE_FRAC tolerance, alert (detect_only first) and optionally adopt the surplus qty.
